_about: Criteria of tests/m1_clean/run_tests.py. Reference values measured 2026-11-23 with commit 512cf768a (branch m1-clean-release), CPU, GCC 13, -ffp-contract=off, MPCDF Raven. max / min: bounds; equal: exact values; near: [reference, relative tolerance] (lists: the last element, i.e. the finest level); last: true applies max / min to the last element of a list only.

momentum_box._about: a report: dP_max / dP_cyc are recorded, not bounded; the test passes when the run completes with finite dP and no CLEAN WARNING

radwave._about: per case (thin, mid, one, trapped): |c_ph/c_ph,exact - 1|, |d(damping)|/omega and the damping per radian (> 0: no growth); dt_gain: dt with / without hydro/rad_signal_speed_diff at x = 0.01

wedge_sym._about: fphi = |sum F_phi| / sum |F_r| on the 20 deg (exact), 3.7 and 7.3 deg (vet_gd_wall_sym) wedges; wedge_fatal = 1: the narrow wedge without the key stops with the FATAL

floor_pay._about: dE from cycle 1 on; dE0 (the t = 0 -> 1 jump: the initial floor energy paid after the t = 0 output) is reported, not bounded
